system.description:
Usage worn.

This small silver locket contains no portrait. When opened, its polished interior occasionally reflects a face that is not quite the wearer's own.

You gain a +1-status bonus to saving throws against effects that alter, erase, suppress or replace your memories or identity. You may also use the Past-Life Insight ability:

Past-Life Insight

Activate Free (0 AP)

Trigger You attempt a Recall Knowledge check

Frequency 1/day

You gain Advantage on the triggering check.

On the sheet: +1 status is offered on saves against memory or identity effects; Use queues Advantage on your next Recall Knowledge (1/day).

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

conditionals.label: Ancestor's Locket
conditionals.scope: Saving throws against effects that alter, erase, suppress or replace your memories or identity
